lines.text: Sponsored By: Rotaract Bequia, Caribbean Conservation Association

c4107261.notes: Weathered island welcome billboard over a beach photo, decorative outlined lettering; dim overcast exposure. Bullet points are round dots.

c65376320.notes: Tourism history board at Fort Charlotte, Kingstown, with two cannon pictures; only the header is transcribed — five paragraphs of history follow (includes 'Queen Charlottle' and 'headquaters' typos on the board). SVG tourism and heritage logos in the corners.

c5008818.reason: scan of a Russian presidential decree document, not a sign photo

c9804028.notes: Blue welcome board at Union Island airport. Distractors: small 'FORT HILL / HISTORICAL SITE' arrow sign and a 'TOBAGO CAYS MARINE PARK / Welcomes you to / UNION ISLAND' billboard at right (same template as c132732925).

c129490604.notes: Port Authority welcome billboard with photo roundels, national flag and an inset map of the islands at right (tiny map labels such as KINGSTOWN, Bequia, Mustique are distractors). Logos: 'St.Vincent and The Grenadines' tourism, 'St.Vincent and the Grenadines Port Authority' seal.

c132732925.notes: Tourism billboard at Saline Bay, Mayreau, over an aerial photo of the Tobago Cays; the bottom script lines are slanted.
